english.title: Fishing vessel owner / skipper / crew member appointed by skipper fail to inspect food and catering facilities
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the

(A)_[owner]_
(B)_[skipper]_

of a fishing vessel, namely **(..SPECIFY VESSEL..), on board which there had not been, at intervals not exceeding 7 days, inspections of the

(C)_[supplies of food and drinking water on board to check with compliance with regulation 22]_
(D)_[catering facilities to check compliance with regulation 23]_

of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018 by

(E)_[you or a crew member appointed to do so by you]_
(F)_[the skipper or a crew member appointed by him to do so]_
(G)_[the skipper or a crew member appointed by her to do so]_

and accompanied by at least one other member of the crew
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 24(1) and (2) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
